MATCHING LIDS & PERFECT SIZES – Each of our storage containers are paired with matching lids and come in large to small sizes. Making it easy to match the containers’ lids together and have the perfect amount of storage for all your leftovers.

MADE WITH FOOD GRADE MATERIALS – We’ve cut no corners with our food storage containers by having each one made with food safe and approved BPA-free plastic. Keeping all of your food free of harmful and toxic contaminants.

MICROWAVE, FREEZER, & DISHWASHER SAFE – All of our reusable containers with lids have been carefully constructed to be microwave, freezer, and dishwasher safe. Making them a breeze to clean after each use and to heat up or freeze any leftovers.

CUSTOMER SATISFACTION GUARANTEED – If for any reason you’re not 100% satisfied with your food storage containers, simply contact our friendly customer service experts within 60 days of purchase and they’ll send you a full refund. No questions asked!
description: Sealco Food Storage Containers – Keeping your food organized and kept fresher, longer

Are you tired of trying to preserve your leftovers in large bulky bowls and trying to cover them with messy and frustrating plastic wrap? Do you wish you could easily store your meals and snacks in your freezer and refrigerator without taking up multiple shelves’ worth of space? If so, we’ve got the ideal solution for you!

Let’s face it, the prices of groceries aren’t getting any cheaper. That’s why many of us use a variety of products to try and make our meals and leftovers last as long as possible. But plastic wrap, storage bags, and tin foil only keep provide your food with a thin layer of protection that only lasts a few days. Plus, they can easily tear and aren’t suitable for liquids. So, that’s why at Sealco, we’ve designed our reusable containers with lids that keep all of your food fresher for longer and letting you make the most of the room in your freezer and refrigerator. This 12 piece set of freezer safe containers is also perfect to heat up your meals in the microwave with and when they’re empty, just place them in the dishwasher to get them perfectly clean. Afterwards, you can easily stack them in your cabinets for when you’re ready to use them again.
